notes.title: PhyxBox 0.31F
notes.content:
[b]Update to FX Manager[/b]
1.	FX Manager now supports map prop scanning on load (Attaches to every specified object) 
2.	FX Manager now supports terrain hit effects and sounds
3.	Support for material specific skid sound effects
4.	Improved collision detection for less missed hit sound effects
5.	Improved sound source generation position
6.	Improvements to jerky skid / air sounds
7.	Improvements to subtle tapping and overall volume control 
8.	Fixed excessive gain on hard hits

[b]Other[/b]
1.	Fixed AssetBundleLoader not filtering out unsupported files
2.	Fixed ToolGuns FX Manager not attaching
3.	HOME map updated to test environmental effects

notes.title: PhyxBox - Foundation Update
notes.content:
[b]What’s new?[/b]
PhyxBox 0.30F

•	Move to HDRP
•	Pick up system added
•	Improved overall clarity
•	Added custom prop shader
•	Fixed unstable physics with many fixed joints
•	Fixed a bug where the player could use tools on himself
•	Updated GUI for all in game menu’s
•	Thruster gun / Controller added
•	Dynamic quality settings (Finds and interacts with your maps volume component)
•	Spawn effects on supported props
•	Objects now spawn on the ground
•	Added SSR / Volumetric fog
•	Fixed AxisGun anchor point
•	Fixed wobbly menu
•	Updated animations
•	Improved AxisGun, WeldGun, CollideGun, ResizeGun, CopyGun & BubbleGun usability and feedback
•	Fixed an AxisGun case where objects would remain frozen if the tool got destroyed during a weld
•	Fixed a case where SmartWeld mode would enter an unbreakable loop in a specific scenario
•	Fixed a case where objects would remain frozen if the weld gun got destroyed during a weld
•	Fixed a case where SmartWeld could double select the first object causing issues
•	Fixed a case where Player could change weld modes during an in-progress weld
•	RopeGun removed (for now)
•	Updates to all maps
•	Increased RecticleGun freeze force threshold


[b]Known bugs[/b]
•	High GPU usage
•	Fullscreen desktop mode causes performance glitches
•	Deleting object in hand can sometimes result in hand disappearing
